Probability-area normalization yields h8/C8(1)=11/3 and exact condition sqrt(18/7). All boundary cases in the declared even-degree domain are checked.

value.rationale: E8 projective root lines are a classical exceptional tight design with 120 sampling sites; knowing the least single even degree giving interpolation and its sharp condition number is a natural spectral question. Full rank at degree eight, failure at ten and permanent recovery after twelve is not the monotonic interpolation behavior that a routine dimensional argument would imply. The all-degree result identifies precisely the finite exceptional harmonics and the complete stability cutoff.
